arguments.message:
Hi there,

The CSV export is limited to 10,000 rows per download in the browser. When you try to export a whole year, the file gets truncated once that limit is reached. To get the complete data you have a couple of options:

1. **Split the export** – narrow the date range (e.g., export one month at a time) and run the export multiple times, then combine the CSV files.
2. **Scheduled export to cloud storage** – set up a scheduled export that writes the full, uncapped history to a cloud storage destination (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.). This method isn’t subject to the 10‑k‑row cap.

Either approach will give you the full year’s worth of records. Let us know if you need help setting up the scheduled export.

Thanks!
